text: In hv's Herdr the mod, opened as a pane, shows each account's weekly bar, reset, state and the `next` marker from ccusage's own JSON, refreshes by itself, and passes `herdr-app check`.

state.evidence: hv's look on 2026-11-17 in hv's own Herdr, the mod installed with ccusage herdr install from ic's build at 9be58a6 (herdr-app check passed) and opened as a tab of its own: hv's screenshots in vc's window show each of the five accounts' weekly bar filled to its percent, its reset, its state tags (active, next, eligible, at the 95% cap), the next marker and predict's line, from ccusage's own JSON. It refreshes by itself: with the panel open and nobody running ccusage against the real config, every account's usage was fetched every five minutes from 06:23:52Z to 06:48:53Z (ccusage's usage cache and history.jsonl, read by vc with date -u). ccusage herdr launch and the panel's larger text (hv's decision 15) are covered by AC-08.4 and by ic's run at 23a7640.
